title: Core77 at the London Design Museum — Bamboo Bicycle Club's Live 3D-Printed Build
body_html:
<!-- RETRACTION NOTICE — for James / editor only, not for publication.

The current post claims Core77 named BBC's "BIY kit" the most hands-on bike of 2016 and reproduces quotes that literally name "Bamboobee." Those are Bamboobee's press, not BBC's. There is NO genuine BBC Core77 "5-hours / best of 2016" coverage to summarise.

Two clean options: A) Delete/retract this post entirely (cleanest — it represents coverage that does not exist). B) Repurpose the handle into BBC's genuine Core77 credit, drafted below from verified facts only. -->

Featured in Core77: building the "Bike of the Future" at the London Design Museum

Industrial-design publication Core77 covered Bamboo Bicycle Club's live build at the London Design Museum in 2016 — a public demonstration of a bamboo bicycle frame joined with 3D-printed lugs, part of the museum's exhibition programme.

Verified Core77 coverage: "Creating the 'Bike of the Future' in a Live 3D Printing and
Bicycle Build at the London Design Museum" (Core77, 2016).

That build placed BBC's open-source, hand-built approach alongside some of the most talked-about design objects of the year, and reflects what the workshops are really about: putting frame-building tools in people's hands rather than selling a finished bike off a shelf.

<!-- DO NOT re-add any of the following — they are unverified or belong to another company: - "build in under 5 hours" / "BIY 2 kit" / "$249" — these are BAMBOOBEE's product. - "Named Best of 2016" — Core77's 2016 roundup named BAMBOOBEE, not BBC. - The Core77 quotes "...wonderful tool for mechanically inclined people..." and "...the most hands-on bike moment of 2016 was the return of the Bamboobee..." — both describe Bamboobee. Real, verifiable BBC figures only: 4,000+ builders trained, 36+ countries, since 2012. -->

Verified BBC stats: 4,000+ builders trained · 36+ countries · building bamboo frames since 2012.

Read the genuine Core77 coverage of bikes in 2016: https://www.core77.com/posts/59041/The-Best-of-Bikes-in-2016
